text: Treat repository test assertions as the drafting keyboard: a read-only extractor emits exact wording/model literals and source spans for paste-in, never paraphrase.
rationale: The next checker consumes authoritative literals, separating guidance drift from product behavior.

text: Add a JSON type lens that prints runtime types, path grammar, and one known-good accessor for every field a verification script touches.
rationale: Path/str mismatches surface before bespoke assertion iterations.

text: Make git diff the launch ramp: emit changed product inputs, affected tests, and the exact required packaging command, without suppressing commands.
rationale: Unchanged-product probes become visibly unnecessary while required tests remain proof.

text: Collapse report navigation into a canonical pointer token—file, line, and anchor—generated read-only and pasted into final inspection.
rationale: Pointer inspection remains independent while hand-written link-resolution scripts disappear.

text: When a prose assertion fails, surface its failing literal, producer test, and source owner beside the traceback.
rationale: Execution mistakes route directly to the contract without adding a report-validation gate.

text: Let workers attach prior command output by reference to acceptance context instead of replaying unchanged checks solely to quote results.
rationale: Evidence reuse becomes explicit and auditable while substantive checks remain unchanged.
